subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally execute standalone JSON from assistant content as a shared fallback for Ollama, LM Studio, and xAI, or should the linked failure be repaired only in native Ollama response conversion?
rationale: The source patch is coherent, but repository inspection cannot determine the real failing response shape; choosing the wrong boundary either leaves the reported bug unfixed or expands text-to-execution behavior unnecessarily.

options.title: Keep fallback after live proof
options.body: Retain the shared parser only after a redacted Ollama run shows JSON in assistant content and successful safe execution.

options.title: Fix native Ollama conversion
options.body: If the response contains structured `tool_calls`, move the repair to Ollama conversion and avoid broadening fallback execution.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Leave the PR draft until provider-runtime ownership and real response evidence settle the boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback after live proof
recommendation.body: Retain the shared parser only after a redacted Ollama run shows JSON in assistant content and successful safe execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared provider seam and the relevant Ollama tool-call history most strongly route this boundary decision here.
